Makoto Ishii (Japanese: 石井真 Ishii Makoto) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Ishii was born on February 24, 1976, in , , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He occasionally lent his voice to the during and . Then, during , he voiced his best-known role, which was Cress, one of the three Striaton City Gym Leaders and brothers. Ishii is currently affiliated with Remax.
